source_findings.finding: The donor distinguishes user-intent admission for external task dispatch from ordinary model function-call execution: frank_auftrag_stellen requires a second mechanically matched human utterance, while frank_erinnerung_schreiben commits a bounded persistent conversational-memory row immediately.

The direct memory writer is scoped to gespraech_erinnerung and explicitly avoids durable_memory. This is not arbitrary database write authority and does not itself prove an external EffectGate bypass.

Realtime call_id/pending-call lifecycle already supplies a useful per-invocation predecessor: function_call_output is keyed by call_id and queued calls are discarded on interrupted/cancelled turns. The current donor effect hook path separately loses per-call identity by correlating through session state, so Frankenstein 2.0 must preserve invocation identity across the bridge rather than only inside Realtime.

architecture_deltas_for_triggerword4.delta: Introduce a typed HumanIntentDecision separate from EffectDecision. Every mutating Realtime tool must declare mutation_class = EPHEMERAL_STATE | CANONICAL_INTERNAL_MUTATION | EXTERNAL_EFFECT_REQUEST | SESSION_CONTROL, plus invocation_id, request_digest, session/generation/causal identity, policy_version and provenance.

HumanIntentDecision must state whether confirmation is IMPLICIT_ALLOWED, EXPLICIT_REQUIRED, EXPLICIT_CONFIRMED, DENIED or UNKNOWN. The confirmation policy may differ by mutation class, but it must be deterministic, inspectable and bound to the exact invocation; a model tool description is not authority.

External effects require both applicable human-intent admission and canonical EffectGate authorization. Human confirmation cannot substitute for EffectGate, and a successful effect cannot retroactively mint either admission decision.

Preserve the donor's useful cancellation invariant: pending function calls from a cancelled/barge-in response must become CANCELLED_BEFORE_SUBMISSION and must never execute later. After submission, uncertainty becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than cancellation success.

Carry one immutable invocation identity from Realtime call_id/tool_use_id-equivalent through HumanIntentDecision -> EffectRequest/EffectDecision where applicable -> executor submission -> EffectJournal -> result/world verification -> causal re-entry. Reject identity or request-digest mismatch.

Do not grant VoiceSessionCapsule or Presence improvements from source existence alone. Add a provenance-bearing per-response context compiler and preserve missing Presence as UNKNOWN/None with WAIT/ASK/re-observe behavior; validate with field lesion/shuffle and missing-sensor regression tests.

preserved_contradictions.claim_a: External task dispatch requires explicit second-utterance confirmation in the Realtime donor.
preserved_contradictions.claim_b: Bounded persistent conversational-memory mutation does not use that confirmation path.
preserved_contradictions.resolution_boundary: Source establishes different policies, not which policy Frankenstein 2.0 should adopt. Decide by mutation class, reversibility, provenance and user-expectation tests.

preserved_contradictions.note: Inspected _response_erstellen instructions do not serialize self.capsule; indirect uninspected paths remain a falsifier.
Inspected missing-Presence fallbacks can map absence to user_present=True; Triggerword-4 successor must retain UNKNOWN.

acceptance_tests_for_triggerword4: Mutation-class table covers every Realtime function-call tool; no mutating branch is unclassified.
Explicit-confirmation-required mutation cannot execute/commit with only model self-confirmation or replayed old transcript text.
Invocation/request-digest mismatch between HumanIntentDecision and downstream request is rejected.
Cancelled-before-submission call never executes after barge-in or response restart.
Submitted call with lost transport/result evidence becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is not blindly replayed.
Bounded conversational-memory mutation either carries an explicit approved implicit-policy receipt or requires confirmation; policy is visible and testable.
Presence missing yields UNKNOWN/None and does not silently become present.
VoiceSessionCapsule field lesion/shuffle changes only intended response-conditioning dimensions; if no measurable effect, capsule conditioning remains unproven.
next_exact_gate: Audit the complete Realtime TOOLS declaration and all mutating _tool_ausfuehren branches, then trace immutable call_id across the bridge into host/executor identity; in parallel continue Git chronology of the historical blocking gate.
